payload.body: One side keeps asking questions while the other treats every question as a delay. Mercury opposite Mars can turn missing information into a fight about timing, especially when the planner sees changing terms and the operator sees a clock that is already running out. Explanation and execution both matter here. The team needs enough information to know what it is doing and a point where discussion ends. Decide which unanswered question could materially change the move, answer that one, and stop using the rest to postpone a decision.
